name: sharpai/deepcamera
description: An AI camera and surveillance platform with local vision-language analysis (Qwen, DeepSeek, SmolVLM, LLaVA, YOLO26), exposing camera skills through a skill store so a deployment agent can set up analysis channels on local camera feeds.
install: Install skills from the Aegis Skill Store UI (one-click setup with no terminal needed per README; deployment agent reads the skill SKILL.md manifest and runs the right backend commands)
